name: print-cost-estimator
description: 3D print cost and time estimator: load an STL, get material weight, print time and a price quote. Runs in your browser.

paragraphs: What will this 3D print cost? Load an STL (or OBJ), pick a filament or resin, and get the model's volume and surface area, the material weight and filament length, an estimated print time and a full price quote: material, electricity, machine depreciation, labor, failure allowance, markup and tax. Optionally load the sliced G-code to use the slicer's own time and filament numbers. Everything runs in your browser.
features: STL (binary and ASCII) and OBJ, with a drag-to-rotate preview, bounding box, volume, surface area and triangle count. Warns about open (non-watertight) meshes and inverted normals. Built-in samples load instantly.
Material presets: PLA, PETG, ABS, ASA, TPU, Nylon and standard resin, each with an editable density and price per kg.
Material from walls and infill: wall count and line width, top/bottom layers, infill percentage, supports and waste/purge percentages. Resin supports solid or hollowed models.

Time estimate from a volumetric flow limit, layer overhead and warm-up, or from G-code: the slicer's own estimate (Cura, PrusaSlicer/SuperSlicer, OrcaSlicer/Bambu Studio, Simplify3D comments) and filament use, or a…

Quote: material, electricity (average power), machine depreciation (price over lifetime), labor, failure allowance, markup, tax, quantity and per-unit price. Copy it as text, download a .txt, or print / save as PDF.
